The £5,050 challenge, part 2: how to actually keep going 🌿

The rules in one line: numbers 1 to 100, tick a number, move that £ to savings. Tick all 100 and you've saved £5,050.

The pace that works:
• 2 ticks a week ≈ £101 on average — all 100 done in 50 weeks
• Tight week? Tick small — £3 + £8 still counts
• Good week? Bank a big number and jump ahead
• Missed a week? Two small ticks next week — no restarting, no guilt
